bureau: birourile istoriilor de credit (credit history bureaus)
note: The Law on Credit History Bureaus (No. 122/2008), article 8(1), as the National Bank of Moldova publishes it (amendments marked to 2021): a bureau keeps a credit history five years from the last change to the debtor's obligation data. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Legea nr. 122/2008 privind birourile istoriilor de credit (Banca Națională a Moldovei)
sources.said: Biroul istoriilor de credit asigură păstrarea istoriilor de credit timp de 5 ani de la data ultimei modificări a informaţiei despre obligaţiile debitorului
